purpose: Fail-closed provenance contract for intentional squash-merge divergence

requirements.merge_parent: merge must have exactly one parent and that parent must equal base_sha
requirements.divergence: BASE->PR_HEAD and BASE->MERGE may differ only when reconciliation evidence explicitly enumerates the complete divergent path set
requirements.dropped_or_changed_paths: every divergent path must be enumerated
requirements.canonical_conflict_proof: each divergent path must be proven stale or conflicting against canonical BASE
requirements.accepted_payload: the post-reconciliation merge payload must be independently identified and verified
requirements.unauthorized_change_check: no change outside the accepted payload or enumerated reconciliation set is permitted
requirements.authority: reconciliation evidence has merge_authority=false and self_certification=false
